Snipe story sources

Snipe reads selected public story pages from Trenches On, meme.com, and OpenSea, with a Backpack community Reddit source attempted for IONQ. Name-based public web search provides additional leads. These are page lookups, not full publisher feeds or live X collection.

Cards distinguish related narratives from sources identifying the exact contract. A price listing or social link alone is not an explanation. Unavailable sources and searches without a story are shown separately.
